quote:
You spend years building walls around your fragile heart. 
You guard every entrance against the ghost of old pain. 
Then someone walks softly through a door you left unlocked. 
They do not ask permission to enter your quiet spaces. 
They simply sit beside the ruins you refused to clear. 
Suddenly the fortress you engineered feels completely useless against their grace.
